en.title: Celadon · Smart mastering plugin
en.description: A mastering plugin: BALANCE → CLAY → COLOR → LIMIT in a fixed order, with one GLAZE knob that listens to the song before deciding how far to push. VST3 / AU for macOS and Windows.
en.twitterDescription: Four stages in a fixed order, and one GLAZE knob that listens to the song before deciding how far to push.
en.imageAlt: Celadon: a crackle-glazed celadon knob on a paper-coloured ground, next to the line “One insert on the master bus. It just sounds right.”

zh.title: Celadon 青瓷 · 一挂总轨，就好听。

zh.twitterDescription: 自用母带插件：四道工序按固定顺序走，一个 GLAZE 旋钮先听这首歌，再决定推多远。
zh.imageAlt: Celadon 青瓷：纸色底上一枚带开片的豆青瓷旋钮，旁边写着「一挂总轨，就好听。」
